sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: The candidate faithfully represents the COMPLETE DIRECT_STATIC contract: it targets ship, preserves the ship-owned status check, includes both declared ship-to-crew paths without using them as an alternative union, and checks each hasCrewMember crew member, assigned duty, relevant PWOM item, familiarization record, and record-item pairing. No additional existence constraints are inferred from the universal coverage rule, and deterministic validation is valid.
